gates.requiredScope: Validate active run state, branch, accepted intake and current series-review hashes at every phase boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Before each semantic phase and delivery action.

gates.requiredScope: Prove the canonical baseline manifest, all controlled document hashes, exactly twelve checklist families and exactly 157 unique IDs.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any secure-development baseline or manifest change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove observable RED failure before the real matrix and GREEN success for all 157 canonical rows using both entrypoints.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After matrix schema, validator or checklist source changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove every positive row has concrete evidence, every N/A/Open/FollowUp row has its mandatory rationale and follow-up data, and Human-only decisions are not claimed.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any assessment row or evidence reference changes.

gates.requiredScope: Validate Baseline, Delta, Closure and Image Impact independently and require a successful technical assurance status and separate independent review.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any assurance evidence, accepted risk or review change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove NIST SSDF, CWE Top 25, C# secure-coding, STRIDE/CAPEC, SAMM and regulatory applicability decisions without certification or legal claims.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After a finding, architecture, product, legal-source or baseline change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove current dependency, SBOM, VEX disposition, SLSA/Provenance and OpenSSF evidence for the unchanged distributable product without overstating assurance.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After dependency, build, workflow, artefact or advisory changes.

gates.requiredScope: Assess OWASP ASVS verification scope.
gates.rationale: TinyCalc is a local TUI with no Web, API, HTTP, authentication or authorization service in this feature.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Introduction of a Web, API, HTTP, authentication or remotely reachable service.

gates.requiredScope: Assess AI-SBOM for released or operated AI components.
gates.rationale: AI is development tooling only; no model, dataset, inference service or AI runtime ships with TinyCalc.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: An AI model, dataset, inference service or AI runtime becomes a product component.

gates.requiredScope: Assess NIST Zero Trust architecture applicability.
gates.rationale: The unchanged product is a local single-process TUI and this feature adds no distributed trust boundary.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Cloud, remote, service-based or networked product architecture.

gates.requiredScope: Prove DE-first/EN-second CEFR-B2 and WCAG 2.2 AA text-first readability of all new reader-facing artefacts.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any reader-facing content or navigation change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove all thirteen installed governance presets and the current intake series remain valid and no unrelated feature was started.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After preset, series, registry or feature-state changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove Documentation Impact UpdateRequired, repository-internal distribution, no Home sync, no unintended agent-guidance change and current project statistics.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After documentation scope, agent guidance, statistics or distribution changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove no product-code, public-API, DocFX, dependency or workflow delta beyond the approved assessment additions to ci.yml, and validate exact intended delivery paths before each commit.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Before each commit and after any worktree change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove unchanged product restore, Release build, full xUnit suite and exact SMOKE_OK output with aligned feature version and build counter.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After source, project, version, dependency or build-environment changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove homogeneity, agent-secret, gitleaks and PowerShell static-analysis gates without tracked secrets, runtime state or private absolute paths.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After script, agent-surface, evidence or secret-scan configuration changes.

gates.requiredScope: Prove exact-head PR check and review convergence with no unresolved actionable thread or changes-requested decision.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After every PR commit, review, check rerun or base update.

gates.requiredScope: Validate a temporary schema-2.0 PreMerge snapshot for the exact reviewed head with one Primary row per gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: After any gate, review, evidence or head change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove MergeAndSync, formal-only bypass authority if needed, provider merge commit and parents, local main fast-forward, causal PostMerge evidence and no product delta.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Immediately before merge and after any authority, policy, head or provider-state change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove final read-only validation, terminal run-state closeout, branch cleanup and the boundary that GSDB starts only after complete RL-SE MergeAndSync.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: At final closeout and before starting any successor feature.
